home.subtitle: I build mobile apps with React Native, Expo and Firebase, working with AI agents: I write the spec, review the diff and own the result.

about.title: About
about.description: I'm Juanpa. I've spent two years building mobile apps with React Native, Expo and Firebase, from idea to store.
about.bio: I'm studying Computer Engineering at TEC in Costa Rica, with two years to go. I'm looking for an internship I can combine with classes, on a team that already runs code in production.
about.referencesDescription#1: "Working with Juanpa was an excellent experience. He always proposes creative solutions and knows how to listen."
about.referencesDescription#2: "Juanpa is responsible, organized, and has great ability to solve technical problems calmly."

timeline.2023: Shipped my first mobile app with Expo and Firebase.
timeline.2024: First freelance client: a real site, with a deadline and someone waiting for it.
timeline.2025: Started building with AI agents: specs, AGENTS.md, and reviewing every diff.

about.photoAlt: Juanpa Quesada Caballero, mobile developer in Costa Rica

descriptions.project1: Classifying farmland meant cross-checking national technical criteria by hand. The app does it in the field.
descriptions.project2: An internet installation company had nothing but WhatsApp as a storefront. I built them a site that captures requests.
descriptions.project3: This site. My testbed for performance, accessibility and my agent workflow.
